playtestingPriorities.intro: The following effects should be monitored particularly closely.

items.note: Evaluate its performance against both low-Damage attacks and high-Damage attacks. Backlash is independent of Armor quality, so heavily armored Units may benefit disproportionately.
Three additional Attack dice can generate substantial damage with powerful single-model weapons. Its lack of rerolls and Blunder penalty should be evaluated against this upside.
Two friendly Attacks gaining Accurate 1 may be efficient, particularly when one attacks with a large dice pool.
Charge 2 on standard 2D6 Charges substantially improves reliability while extending their maximum reach. Monitor its effects on the frequency of successful Engagements.
Standard four-model generic Ranged Infantry now qualify. Test whether its conditional +3 Attacks creates too much ranged output when paired with inexpensive formations.
Tough 2 over an entire Combat Phase can prevent considerable damage if one Unit is attacked multiple times. Compare it against one-Attack defensive Reactions.

Most commands are usable by any suitable Unit, regardless of its recruitment category. Monitor whether certain expensive Characters and high-Damage Assets consistently become the optimal recipients of generic offensive buffs.

playtestingPriorities.draftStatus: All sixteen doctrines and eighty selectable commands are included. Existing recruitment-slot distributions are preserved. Numerical balance remains provisional pending tabletop testing.
